Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 127. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A supercharged combo that breaks through defenses.
Make 2 combo attack rolls dealing your unarmed
strike+3d10 bludgeoning damage each on a hit. This
damage cannot be lessened by blocking.
